Definition: a log or measure for liquids
BiblicalUsage: lôg means a log, a measure of oil. In Leviticus 14:10, "and one log of oil."; and in Leviticus 14:12, "and the log of oil". In Leviticus 14:15, "And the priest shall take [some] of the log of oil".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the log of oil is the measure of cleansing — poured on the leper's head, waved before the Lord, and enough to make the unclean clean.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
